title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Westbury Music Fair, Jericho | 1999
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Westbury Music Fair in Jericho, New York, USA, on 21 February 1999.

It was the eighth show by the fifth All-Starr Band. Their US tour lasted for 30 dates in February and March 1999.

Starr returned to the venue on 24 February 1999, 16 and 17 May 2000, 4 and 5 August 2003, 12 and 14 July 2006, 29 June 2008, 30 June 2010, and 11 June 2014.

The fifth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, percussion
  • Gary Brooker: vocals, keyboards, organ
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Timmy Cappello: vocals, saxophone, keyboards, harmonica, guitar
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums

  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Act Naturally’
  • ‘Whisky Train’ (Gary Brooker)
  • ‘I Saw The Light’ (Todd Rundgren)
  • ‘Sunshine Of Your Love’ (Jack Bruce)
  • ‘Shooting Star’ (Simon Kirke)

  • ‘All Right Now’ (Simon Kirke)
  • ‘I Wanna Be Your Man’

  • ‘White Room’ (Jack Bruce)

  • ‘Photograph’

  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
